playstyle.identity: Irelia is a blade dancer who dashes repeatedly through enemies. She excels at weaving through teamfights, resetting Q through marked targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks with abilities for bonus damage. Q dashes to target and resets if it kills or hits marked targets. W reduces damage and deals it on release. E throws blades that stun between them and mark. R throws blades that mark and create a wall. E-R to mark, then Q through everything.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Irelia spikes at level 6 with R marks and with BOTRK. She's strong at all-ins throughout mid-game.

passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.summary: Stack attack speed with abilities; at max stacks, deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Hitting enemies with abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, Irelia gains bonus attack speed and deals bonus magic damage on-hit.

abilities.name: Bladesurge
abilities.summary: Dash to a target; resets on kill or hitting marked targets.
abilities.details: Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing damage and healing. If it kills or the target is marked, the cooldown resets.

abilities.name: Defiant Dance
abilities.summary: Reduce incoming damage while channeling; release to deal damage.
abilities.details: Irelia channels, reducing physical damage taken. On release, she deals damage in a direction, increased by damage taken during channel.

abilities.name: Flawless Duet
abilities.summary: Place two blades that connect, stunning and marking enemies between.
abilities.details: Irelia throws a blade, then throws a second. The blades connect, stunning enemies between them and marking them for Q reset.

abilities.name: Vanguard's Edge
abilities.summary: Throw blades that mark champions and create a damaging wall.
abilities.details: Irelia throws a barrage of blades, damaging and marking enemy champions. The blades form a wall that damages and slows enemies who pass through.
